CoolDock is an award-winning second Dock for macOS. It sits beside your original Dock, so nothing about your current setup changes, and gives you a live strip of widgets, apps, folders and quick actions built for the way you actually work.

CoolDock brings music, todos, calendar events, weather, search, system stats, quick actions, and more useful widgets into one beautiful live dock. Pick from more than 160 widgets across 20 categories, from clocks and reminders to revenue, AI plan usage, and everyday tools like clipboard, screenshots and AirDrop, and pin the apps, folders and files you reach for most.

Your Mac’s Dock can do much more than just open apps.  
  
Meet CoolDock, a customisable second Dock for macOS that puts your everyday tools, live widgets and useful information right at your fingertips without constantly opening different apps.  
  
Here’s what makes it useful:  
  
→ 160+ smart widgets: Access tools for productivity, system monitoring, business analytics and more.  
→ AI usage tracking: Keep an eye on usage stats for tools like Claude, Codex, Gemini and other supported AI services.  
→ Productivity tools: Keep your calendar, reminders, to-do lists, Pomodoro timer and notes within reach.  
→ Music and weather: Check the weather, control music and view useful updates directly from your Dock.
